1.desc: When a young football talent from a small town appears to have been killed in a black magic sacrifice ritual, the CBI investigation focuses on a self-proclaimed Wiccan witch, whose cat was allegedly tortured and killed by the victim prior to his death.

1.desc: Patrick Jane and the CBI team track down a mastermind who hypnotizes people into doing their bidding.

1.title: A Dozen Red Roses
1.desc: Patrick Jane and the team go to Hollywood when they investigate the murder of a movie producer.

1.title: Red Sauce
1.desc: Patrick Jane and the team investigate the murder of a mobster who was in witness protection.

1.title: Miss Red
1.desc: Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to play suspects off each other in order to solve the case of a wealthy software company CEO found murdered on his yacht.

1.title: Blood Brothers
1.desc: Patrick Jane must find a clever way to convince the troubled kids at a wilderness program to confide in him about what really happened surrounding the death of one of their peers.

1.desc: Lisbon fears that serial killer Red John is drawing Patrick Jane into a trap when the CBI team investigates the murder of a young girl and the abduction of her twin sister.

2.desc: The CBI team are faced with a violent and shocking crime in their own offices, but must work the case in spite of their alarm at who may be behind it.

2.desc: Patrick Jane and the team are called to investigate the robbery and murder of a wealthy jeweler while attending a black tie fundraiser for the CBI.

2.desc: While Jane and the team examine the crime scene where a baseball scout is found murdered, Jane is clocked in the head by a ball and flashes back to his childhood with his overbearing father.

2.desc: Rigsby goes undercover as an alum at a 15th high school reunion when Patrick Jane and the team investigate a double homicide that may be linked to an old prank.

2.desc: While investigating the death of a mayor's media liaison, Jane is kidnapped by an eco-terrorist who is a suspect in the case. Meanwhile, the team reluctantly agrees to be filmed for a documentary.

2.title: Redline
2.desc: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate when the body of a high-end luxury car sales woman is found in the trunk of a Bentley in the dealership's showroom.

2.title: Blood In, Blood Out
2.desc: When a member of Cho's former gang, the Avon Park Playboys, is found murdered, Patrick Jane insists on helping Cho with his off-the-books investigation.

2.title: Red Herring
2.desc: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an arrogant chef during a cooking competition in Napa Valley.

2.title: Code Red
2.desc: When Dr. Alicia Seberg, a government research scientist, is exposed to a deadly toxin while at work and has only hours to live, she calls Patrick Jane and the CBI to find her murderer.

2.title: The Red Box
2.desc: While investogating the murder of an English tutor who stole a valuable artifact from a British museum, Patrick Jane, Lisbon, and the CBI team brace themselves to finally meet their new boss, Madeleine Hightower.

2.title: Aingavite Baa
2.desc: When a Jane Doe with amnesia and covered in blood steps in front of Cho and Van Pelt's car, Patrick Jane must use all of his skills to discover who she is, her last location, and why she lost her memory.

2.title: Blood Money
2.desc: When Patrick Jane's sneaky conduct causes the case of a confessed hitman to be tossed out of court, his annoyed CBI team must start the investigation over from scratch.

2.title: Red All Over
2.desc: When a media mogul is murdered, Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate cult leader Bret Stiles, who may have had an axe to grind following the publication of a critical story about his group.
Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the death of a mathematical genius by a gun-wielding clown.

2.title: Red Letter
2.desc: Romantic sparks begin to fly when Patrick Jane and supposed psychic Kristina Frye cross paths again during the CBI investigation into the murder of a charismatic head of a non-profit organization that fights human trafficking.

2.title: Red Sky in the Morning
2.desc: Patrick Jane and Kristina's first date is interrupted by a report of Red John striking again, which is discovered to be a copycat. But when Kristina reaches out to the real Red John, both she and Jane find themselves in grave danger.

3.title: Red Sky at Night
3.desc: When the CBI investigates the kidnapping of a prominent lawyer and state house lobbyist, the CBI Director wants Jane on the case, but he is uncertain of his future with the unit after his encounter with Red John.

3.title: Cackle-Bladder Blood
3.desc: When Jane's brother-in-law returns to town and gets mixed up in a murder investigation, Jane must come to his aid despite personal reservations.

3.title: The Blood on His Hands
3.desc: When Patrick Jane faces off once again with cult leader Bret Stiles, Stiles offers Jane information regarding Red John and the missing Kristina Frye.

3.title: Red Carpet Treatment
3.desc: Patrick Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the murder of a convict who served nine years for rape and murder, but was recently released on DNA evidence.

3.title: The Red Ponies
3.desc: Patrick Jane and the CBI team hit the horse track when a jockey is found murdered and suspects abound.

3.title: Pink Chanel Suit
3.desc: The case of a murder and missing person on an intensely secure wealthy family's compound perplexes Jane and the CBI team.

3.title: Red Hot
3.desc: Jane and the CBI team narrowly escape a fiery end when a building explodes while they're investigating a death threat. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and billionaire Walter Mashburn when they meet again while on the case.

3.title: Ball of Fire
3.desc: Patrick Jane is kidnapped and Lisbon and the team go back through years of Jane's casework to find suspects only to realize that almost everyone he's ever dealt with might want to harm him.

3.title: Red Moon
3.desc: Patrick Jane accepts the help of a local astrologer/clairvoyant, Ellis Mars, to solve the puzzling case of a triple homicide that involves two policemen and the fiancé of an EMT worker.

3.title: Jolly Red Elf
3.desc: The CBI pursues two lines of investigation when a Santa is murdered: Patrick Jane goes undercover in an AA group; and Rigsby and Van Pelt question members of an authentic Santa society. Meanwhile, following the demise of a person in custody at the CBI, J.J. LaRoche is brought in to question the team when it appears to be an inside job.

3.title: Bloodsport
3.desc: Patrick and the team investigate the murder of a woman with ties to mixed martial arts fighters. Meanwhile, LaRoche focuses his investigation on Rigsby, who in turn is forced to ask Cho for a huge favor in order to keep his job.

3.title: Bloodhounds
3.desc: When Patrick Jane and the CBI must work with a criminal profiler, Dr. Montague, to solve a double murder, it becomes a competition for Jane to prove that his methods are superior.

3.title: Red Alert
3.desc: When Patrick Jane and others are taken hostage by an armed man accused of murder, Jane must think quickly to defuse the situation.

3.title: Blood for Blood
3.desc: Van Pelt's actions are called into question when a witness is murdered while she is assigned to his protection.

3.title: Red Gold
3.desc: When a modern-day prospector is found dead near a mining site and Lisbon is injured during the initial stages of the investigation, Agent Hightower joins Patrick Jane in the field for the first time.

3.title: Red Queen
3.desc: Evidence in the murder of an antiques dealer found dead in a museum indicates that the suspect may be a member of the CBI team.

3.title: Bloodstream
3.desc: After a doctor is found dead at a golf course, the CBI team searches for a killer amongst a hospital's staff and patients. Meanwhile, when LaRoche is placed in charge of the CBI, his first act of business is to demote Lisbon, and name Cho the new team leader.

3.title: The Red Mile
3.desc: Patrick Jane and the CBI team must track down the killer of a man who believed he experienced an alien abduction - even after the victim's body is stolen from the coroner's van. Meanwhile, Van Pelt takes a break from the case to shop for wedding dresses.

3.title: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
3.desc: Patrick Jane sets out to prove a beautiful yet manipulative matchmaker shot and killed her husband after his body is found floating in the marina.

3.title: Redacted
3.desc: Patrick Jane must deal with two failed robbery attempts: one resulting in the murder of a repair shop owner and the other involving a former suspect personally hired by Jane to break into LaRoche's home.

3.title: Like a Redheaded Stepchild
3.desc: When a prison guard is stabbed to death outside of a jewelry store, Patrick Jane suspects one of the guard's inmates is the killer. Meanwhile, Rigsby questions his own father about the murder.

3.title: Rhapsody in Red
3.desc: After a young violinist is shot to death, Patrick Jane questions the members of the Northern California Symphony Orchestra about the murder. Meanwhile, Cho crosses paths with a precocious young pickpocket.

3.title: Strawberries and Cream, Part I
3.desc: Jane and the team investigate an explosion at a gas station, involving a thief with a bomb strapped to his chest. However, not everything is quite as it first appears when Jane reveals that the bomber was in fact the victim, and not the real killer.

3.title: Strawberries and Cream, Part II
3.desc: Red John's mole is finally revealed and Patrick Jane comes face-to-face with the serial killer in an explosive confrontation that leads to shocking repercussions.

4.title: Scarlet Ribbons
4.desc: In prison for killing his nemesis, Patrick Jane must prove that the man he shot really was Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon urges Van Pelt to seek counseling in the aftermath of the death of her fiancé, Craig O'Laughlin.

4.title: Little Red Book
4.desc: With Lisbon suspended and the rest of the team reassigned, Jane is reinstated as a CBI consultant and forced to work with a new team. During the investigation, Jane conspires to bring his former team back together.

4.title: Pretty Red Balloon
4.desc: When the son of a former client from Jane's days as a psychic is kidnapped, Jane and the CBI team are asked to help find him. Meanwhile, Jane butts heads with his former client's new "spiritual advisor".

4.title: Ring Around the Rosie
4.desc: Jane notices a suspicious looking man carrying a gun at a political rally and sets out to prove he's a psychopath on the brink of committing murder. Meanwhile, Lisbon investigates the death of a photographer at the same rally.

4.title: Blood and Sand
4.desc: Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of a woman whose body washed up on an island off the coast of California. Meanwhile, Rigsby worries that his relationship with a public defender may create awkwardness between him and Van Pelt.

4.title: Where in the World is Carmine O'Brien?
4.desc: When the CBI team travels to a resort town to find out who murdered a police chief, Lisbon crosses paths with her brother Tommy, now a bounty hunter, who's tracking a bail jumper.

4.title: Blinking Red Light
4.desc: The search for a serial killer hits close to home for Jane when he encounters a blogger who has devoted his life to finding the killer.

4.title: Pink Tops
4.desc: In order to find the killer of an undercover narcotics cop, Jane and the CBI team retrace her investigation.

4.title: The Redshirt
4.desc: Jane and the CBI investigate when a retired NFL star quarterback is presumed dead after his car blows up. Meanwhile, while preparing for a court case, Rigsby and Sarah Harrigan take their relationship to the next level.

4.title: Fugue in Red
4.desc: During the search for a firefighter's killer, Jane is attacked and nearly drowned, resulting in a temporary loss of his memory and a return to his pre-CBI con man persona.

4.title: Always Bet on Red
4.desc: Jane and the CBI must narrow down the long list of suspects after a high-end divorce attorney with many enemies is killed on his speed boat. Meanwhile, Jane is questioned about whether Red John was responsible for Panzer's murder.

4.title: My Bloody Valentine
4.desc: With very little evidence, Jane and the CBI investigate the death of a mob boss' son. Meanwhile, while taking a belligerent witness in for questioning, Van Pelt is haunted by the memories of O'Laughlin's shooting.

4.title: Red Is the New Black
4.desc: Jane and the CBI narrow down the list of suspects after a disgraced clothing designer on the verge of a comeback becomes a fashion victim. Meanwhile, FBI Agent Darcy continues her investigation into finding Red John.

4.desc: While a jury deliberates the guilt or innocence of a defendant on trial for murder, Jane tries to prove she has been wrongfully accused before time runs out. Meanwhile, Summer may have gone too far when she helps Cho make a case against a suspect.

4.title: War of the Roses
4.desc: When a charity worker is killed, Jane has Erica Flynn, a murderer he helped imprison, furloughed in exchange for information she claims to have about the case. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Sarah try to adjust to impending parenthood.

4.title: His Thoughts Were Red Thoughts
4.desc: Jane is reunited with his former nemesis, cult leader Bret Stiles, when the head of an anti-cult activist organization is murdered.

4.title: Cheap Burgundy
4.desc: Jane suspects that Susan Darcy has ulterior motives when she asks for his help with a homicide investigation. Meanwhile, the CBI team handles the murder of a young woman who was killed after meeting someone in an online chat room.

4.desc: Jane and the CBI try to narrow down the list of suspects when a terminally ill man, is found murdered. Meanwhile, Cho is forced to face his demons.

4.desc: Jane and the CBI try to determine who would have reason to kill a popular English teacher, giving Jane an opportunity to show off his acting skills to a drama class. Meanwhile, Cho hides his relationship with Summer from Lisbon, and Rigsby gets a special delivery.

4.desc: After another attempt to find Red John fails, Patrick Jane hits rock bottom at a Las Vegas club in the fourth season finale.

5.desc: While Jane tries to decipher Lorelei's connection to Red John, the CBI team is forced to partner with the FBI to solve the murder of a hotel employee.

5.title: Not One Red Cent
5.desc: A bank employee is murdered during a heist and Jane and the team must work to track down the killer. Meanwhile, Lisbon is pulled deeper into the CBI/FBI rivalry.

5.title: Blood Feud
5.desc: When Rigsby's father is found injured at a crime scene, the team must find out if it is the result of a long-standing small-town gang war.

5.title: Red Dawn
5.desc: Flashing back several years, a distraught Patrick Jane arrives at the CBI to ask for evidence in the Red John investigation. However, while shadowing Libson, Jane winds up helping the team solve the murder of a judge's son.

5.title: Cherry Picked
5.desc: The team investigates the kidnapping of a couple that may be the victim of mistaken identity, while Jane continues his investigation into Lorelei's whereabouts.

5.title: If It Bleeds, It Leads
5.desc: The team investigates the murder of a reporter who may have become too close to her story, while Jane insists on pursuing his own leads to find Lorelei.

5.title: Red Sails in the Sunset
5.desc: With the help of Bret Stiles, Jane orchestrates an elaborate plan to break Lorelei Martins out of prison in the hope that she will lead him to Red John.

5.title: Black Cherry
5.desc: The CBI team investigates the murder of a real estate agent with former gang ties, while Jane searches for leads on his new connection to Red John.

5.title: Panama Red
5.desc: The death of a young botanist leads the team into the lucrative world of medical marijuana, while Cho's work with the rapid response team brings him back into contact with Summer.

5.title: Days of Wine and Roses
5.desc: The CBI team visits a high-end California rehab center in order to investigate the death of a young model who was a patient there, while Lisbon ramps up her investigation into Tommy Volker.

5.title: Little Red Corvette
5.desc: The CBI investigates the death of a geologist, which Lisbon is convinced is the key to bringing down Tommy Volker.

5.title: The Red Barn
5.desc: Jane and the CBI team investigate a 25-year-old case that seems to connect Red John with members of the Visualize cult, and Lisbon contemplates her future.

5.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
5.desc: The team delves into the surprisingly cut-throat world of academics in a case involving a graduate student at a natural history museum, and Jane helps Bertram improve his poker game.

5.title: Red Lacquer Nail Polish
5.desc: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an elderly heiress whose remains are found in the living room of her spooky mansion.

5.title: There Will Be Blood
5.desc: Lorelei Martins returns, determined to find out if Red John had a role in her sister's death, and Jane is forced to confess to Lisbon his part in Lorelei's prison escape.

5.title: Red, White and Blue
5.desc: The CBI team investigates when the body of a female army medic who worked with soldiers with PTSD is found near a military base.

5.title: Behind the Red Curtain
5.desc: The CBI team investigates when the young lead of a local theater production dies on the eve of the opening. Meanwhile, Jane hopes to get more information about Red John from the comatose Jason Lennon.

5.title: Red Letter Day
5.desc: The CSI team heads out to a run-down Wild West tourist town when the owner is found dead. Meanwhile, Kirkland tries to find out how much Jane knows about Red John.

5.title: Red Velvet Cupcakes
5.desc: Rigsby and Van Pelt go undercover as a couple with relationship problems to investigate the death of a woman who received advice from a radio love doctor.

5.title: Red and Itchy
5.desc: LaRoche personally requests Jane's help when the mysterious container he's been hiding for nine years is stolen from his home.

5.title: Red John's Rules
5.desc: Just as Jane narrows down the Red John suspect list to seven, Red John strikes at a victim with links to Jane's past.

6.title: The Desert Rose
6.desc: Jane and Lisbon secretly continue their dangerous mission to narrow down the list of seven Red John suspects as they investigate the murder of a man who was missing for two years.

6.title: Black-Winged Redbird
6.desc: Jane discovers an important clue to Red John's methods as the team encounters four of the suspects, and the CBI investigates the case of a software engineer killed by a drone strike.

6.title: Wedding in Red
6.desc: Jane gets the CBI involved in a murder case in Napa in order to investigate Sheriff McAllister, while Rigsby and Van Pelt contemplate their future in light of a new office policy.

6.title: Red Listed
6.desc: When Jane reveals that a list of fake Red John suspects he planted was stolen, the team races to protect those on the list before harm comes to them.

6.title: The Red Tattoo
6.desc: When a prominent member of Visualize is mysteriously killed, Jane investigates in the hopes that the case will provide a clue that will lead him to Red John.

6.title: Fire and Brimstone
6.desc: With the final clue in hand, Jane attempts to gather the remaining Red John suspects in one place in hopes of finally revealing his identity.

6.title: The Great Red Dragon
6.desc: Following the shocking events at Jane's house, the Red John list is narrowed down further, and the CBI's priority is the remaining suspects.

6.title: Red John
6.desc: Patrick Jane finally comes face-to-face with Red John, the serial killer he's tracked since the madman murdered his wife and daughter. For 10 years, Jane has doggedly hunted his nemesis in his search for justice.

6.title: My Blue Heaven
6.desc: Two years after the Red John case was put to rest, Jane's newfound peace is interrupted by a surprising job offer that could change everything for him.

6.title: Green Thumb
6.desc: The FBI reluctantly enlists Jane's help to find a missing computer programmer, but he refuses to help unless Lisbon is brought on board as well.

6.title: White Lines
6.desc: The FBI is tasked with finding the killer of several DEA agents, and Jane goes on a date with a beautiful woman associated with the case.

6.title: The Golden Hammer
6.desc: Jane and the FBI investigate the murder of a high-tech cartographer who may have unearthed a spy ring before his death. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt find themselves on the trail of an alarming conspiracy.

6.title: Black Helicopters
6.desc: Jane's investigation leads him to join a separatist commune after a U.S. attorney is found dead in Mexico, even though there's no record of her crossing the border. Also, Rigsby and Van Pelt convince J.J. LaRoche to help them discover who is stalking former CBI members.

6.title: Grey Water
6.desc: Jane and Fischer investigate a murder at an oil fracking site, while Rigsby and Van Pelt travel to Austin to help investigate suspects in the string of attacks on former CBI team members.

6.title: White As the Driven Snow
6.desc: Grace is kidnapped by the killer who has been hunting former CBI members, but when the prime suspect appears to have an airtight alibi, Jane must rely on all his skills to locate her before time runs out.

6.title: Violets
6.desc: Jane enlists his colleagues in a dangerous sting operation to catch a deadly team of art thieves. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and an agent from the FBI's art squad.

6.title: Silver Wings of Time
6.desc: Jane and the FBI take up the cause of a death row inmate who has two days to prove his innocence before his sentence is carried out.

6.title: Forest Green
6.desc: When a woman is found murdered near a remote men's social club, Jane must find a way to insinuate himself into the insular group to find the killer.

6.title: Brown Eyed Girls
6.desc: A chance encounter with a suspicious-looking individual leads Jane and Lisbon to uncover a vast human trafficking ring. Meanwhile, Lisbon remains tempted by Pike's offer to move to D.C. with him.

6.title: Il Tavolo Bianco
6.desc: Jane's freedom is at stake when a grand jury is empanelled to decide if he should be tried for the murder of Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon tries to find out how Jane feels about the possibility of her leaving Austin with Marcus Pike, and Cho and Abbott follow new leads in the human trafficking ring they recently uncovered.

6.title: Black Hearts
6.desc: With time running out to save the victims of a kidnapping ring before they are transported overseas, Jane and Lisbon zero in on the criminal enterprise's mastermind. Meanwhile, Lisbon decides if she will move to D.C. with Marcus Pike.

6.title: Blue Bird
6.desc: A new lead in a cold case requires Lisbon to delay her plans to leave for Washington, D.C. with Marcus, giving Jane time to finally come to terms with his feelings for her and decide on a course of action.

7.title: Nothing But Blue Skies
7.desc: Jane and Lisbon decide to keep their new relationship a secret from their colleagues as they investigate the murder of an undercover agent. Also, young, ambitious agent Michelle Vega joins the team.

7.title: The Greybar Hotel
7.desc: Lisbon goes undercover as a prison inmate in order to get a convict to turn on her boyfriend, who is the leader of a high-end car theft ring.

7.title: Orange Blossom Ice Cream
7.desc: Jane and Lisbon travel to Beirut where they must work with former adversary, Erica Flynn, who agrees to help the FBI apprehend her boyfriend, a courier for terrorist organizations, in exchange for amnesty for her past crimes.

7.title: Black Market
7.desc: The team investigates a murder linked to a counterfeit diamond operation, but illness forces Jane to direct his colleagues from the office as he recuperates. Meanwhile, Abbott is concerned that transgressions in his past could harm his wife's chance to obtain a prestigious job in Washington, D.C..

7.title: The Silver Briefcase
7.desc: A chance encounter with a military colonel leads Jane to believe the soldier is hiding something, leading him to dig into the closed murder case of the man's wife.

7.title: Green Light
7.desc: The FBI is brought in to consult on a botched DEA raid, but when Abbott's former boss tries to blackmail Abbott into keeping the agency's missteps quiet, he is forced to choose between his career and morals.

7.title: Little Yellow House
7.desc: A murder investigation becomes personal for Lisbon when she learns that her underachieving younger brother, Jimmy, is being sought as a key witness.

7.title: The Whites of His Eyes
7.desc: Jane worries for Lisbon's safety when the team puts itself in the line of fire to protect the witness in a murder investigation from a skilled assassin.

7.title: Copper Bullet
7.desc: When Abbott's old boss, Bill Peterson, threatens Abbott's career – and possibly his freedom – Jane devises a risky plan to protect his friend's future.

7.title: Nothing Gold Can Stay
7.desc: Jane takes extreme measures as the team tries to apprehend a deadly gang of armored car robbers before their desperation to remain free costs more innocent people their lives.

7.title: Byzantium
7.desc: A young man claiming to have psychic powers offers his help to the FBI in solving a pair of murders, but when he leads them to additional victims, Jane and the team begin to suspect that he is in fact the killer they're hunting.

7.title: Brown Shag Carpet
7.desc: Jane agrees to once again pretend to be a renowned psychic and be used as bait in an attempt to lure out a serial killer and give the FBI a chance to apprehend him.

7.title: White Orchids
7.desc: Lisbon accepts Jane's surprise marriage proposal, but a killer's quest for revenge may cost them the happy ending they've worked so hard to achieve.

1.title: And So It Begins
1.desc: Premiere of a reality series in which 10 adventurers attempt to survive the wilderness of Vancouver Island with whatever they've been able to place into a backpack. Day one has them dealing with a lack of water and the island's large predators.

1.title: Of Wolf and Man
1.desc: While predators continue to cause problems for a number of the men, water soon becomes a crucial hurdle for others. From fast rising tides to relentless rains, each of the men must adapt to his new environment or tap out and go home. It's the fear of dehydration that plagues one man as another finds his survival threatened along the shoreline by a rogue wave. But it will be a quest for a clean water source that sends one man on a perilous journey in a rickety boat made of sticks.

1.title: The Talons of Fear
1.desc: After only a short time in the wild, the men find that extreme isolation is beginning to take its toll. A survivalist undertakes a massive cabin project, one man loses his most important tool and another is charged by a large predator leaving him to fend for his life.

1.title: Stalked
1.desc: As the days pass, the remaining survivalists show signs of cracking. One man battles isolation as another breaks down after missing his daughters 4th birthday. But it's the real dangers of the environment that could spell the end for one participant when he finds himself stalked by a cougar.

1.title: Winds of Hell
1.desc: A storm with gale-force winds pummels the men and rips through their camps, while one survivalist attempts to find a way to set off on the turbulent seas.

1.title: Rain of Terror
1.desc: The remaining participants are finally adapting to the cruel environment, but the hunt for food leads them into harms way; one man is forced to drop his new boat miles from camp.

1.title: The Hunger
1.desc: In the brutally freezing temperatures the hunt for food becomes the paramount focus of the remaining survivalists. While some find gratifying success; others face complete failure and obstacles that beat them down emotionally and push one man to the brink.

1.title: The Freeze
1.desc: Temperatures plummet on the island and the remaining contestants are forced to face the onset of winter head on. One man risks it all with a risky move while everyone struggles with the ongoing effects of isolation and freezing temperatures.

1.title: Brokedown Palace
1.desc: Extreme isolation takes its toll on the remaining participants in the wild. Each man's battle turns to the mind as well as the elements.

1.title: Triumph
1.desc: Two men remain on Vancouver Island as the storm of the year blows in. The unrelenting elements, isolation and starvation confront both remaining participants, forcing one to go home.

2.title: Once More Unto the Breach
2.desc: The first day of the adventure begins, with 10 people prepared to head out into unknown wilderness and survive for as long as they can, in total isolation. But when the survivalists confront rocky terrain, wet environments, and hungry predators, all of them begin to question their resolve.

2.title: The Knife's Edge
2.desc: After several days, the participants attempt to acclimate to their new environment and make order out of chaos. One survivalist proves incredibly skillful and finds enormous success scavenging and hunting for food. Meanwhile, doubts emerge for others as debilitating hunger sets in.

2.title: The Beasts of Night
2.desc: After a week on Vancouver Island, several of the participants find success in their new environment; some work in harmony with the wilderness and others battle against it; careless mistakes threaten to send two people home.

2.title: Hunger's Grip
2.desc: The lack of food takes a toll on the remaining participants after days without eating; starvation impairs the mental and physical capabilities of the participants, pushing some to the edge of surrender.

2.title: Storm Rising
2.desc: The participants continue to battle debilitating hunger, while an approaching storm puts their survival plans in jeopardy.

2.title: Adrift
2.desc: Emotions run high for the remaining participants as they struggle to adapt; one participant wrestles with the solitude, while the other risks it all, taking a perilous journey into the unknown.

2.title: Trial by Fire
2.desc: After three weeks, mental and physical struggles take their toll on the remaining participants; some teeter on calling it quits as they battle deep-seated conflicts.

2.title: The Ascent
2.desc: A participant thrives on the island, while others battle to improve their lot; one man races to a salmon run before it's over; another takes a journey that may be his undoing; and another takes nature's fury head on.

2.title: The Madness
2.desc: After a month in the bush, nature and seclusion prove tough to handle, while some push to tough it out and others question their ability to last.

2.title: The Gamble
2.desc: The final four battle mental fatigue and physical exhaustion, while one faces stiff competition for fish and another's miscalculation may mean missing the salmon run.

2.title: Winter's Fury
2.desc: As winter arrives food sources dwindle and the remaining participants need to take risks.

2.title: Into the Abyss
2.desc: The remaining participants wear thin as starvation and isolation become unbearable; one man faces a potentially deadly situation.

2.title: The End Game
2.desc: In the final days of the competition, the remaining participants battle for supremacy; after pushing their minds and bodies to the breaking point, one of the participants claims the $500,000 prize.

3.title: A New Land
3.desc: Ten new participants are abandoned in the remote wilderness of Patagonia, Argentina, where they must find food and water, build shelters before the onset of winter and fend off predators, such as pumas and wild boar.

3.title: First Blood
3.desc: As they venture deeper into their surroundings, the nine remaining survivalists realize that this terrain is unlike anything they've ever experienced. One participant suffers a serious injury.

3.title: Eternal Darkness
3.desc: The remaining participants dig in for the long haul as they begin building their shelters. While some flourish, others fail and one is threatened by an unwanted visitor in the night.

3.title: Outfoxed
3.desc: The remaining participants are forced to get creative due to a lack of food; one survivalist devises an ingenious method for getting protein, while another battles a wily predator.

3.title: The Lone Wolf
3.desc: The remaining participants struggle to adapt to life in Patagonia. One survivor comes face to face with a stealth cat, and another takes on a major build project. As the days go by, one participant tries a novel strategy to outlast everyone else.

3.title: Along Came a Spider
3.desc: Dangerous challenges wreak havoc on the participants and force most to consider going home. While one is plagued by a potentially life-threatening infection, another battles against serious hypothermia.

3.title: Hungry Beasts
3.desc: As winter draws nearer, and fish stop biting, the participants turn to land game to survive the season. But their intended prey turns out to be more clever--and more deadly--than they could imagine.

3.title: Of Feast & Famine
3.desc: Winter arrives in full force, and the remaining survivors must deal with rapidly deteriorating conditions; the lack of protein pushes some to new levels of depletion; others find the pull to see family more than they can bear.

3.title: The Point of No Return
3.desc: The remaining survivalists push themselves to their physical limits as fish becomes scarce. But one participant takes it too far, reaching the breaking point and risking organ failure.

3.title: Day 87
3.desc: Short of food, the remaining participants risk their lives to be victorious; only one survivalist will be able to endure the wilds of Patagonia to take home the $500,000 prize.

4.title: Divide and Conquer
4.desc: Family members are dropped off miles apart and must navigate the unforgiving terrain of Northern Vancouver Island to find each other; to win the $500,000 prize, the competitors must build their own shelters and forage for their own food.

4.title: Hell on Earth
4.desc: As their teammates attempt to set up camp, the hikers find that Vancouver Island's terrain is even more punishing when on the move; the island beats one pair into submission, while another grapples with a devastating accident.

4.title: Margin of Error
4.desc: On Vancouver Island, a seriously injured participant weighs the risks of seeking medical help and sacrificing his shot at $500,000. Danger awaits all participants as predators continue to stalk the island's newest inhabitants.

4.title: The Last Mile
4.desc: Desperation sinks in as the hikers struggle to make the final push to their teammates. Exhaustion leads one participant straight into the path of a predator, and into a dangerous confrontation.

4.title: Double or Nothing
4.desc: Now that most teams are reunited, they dive into the difficult task of surviving together and feeding two people. Meanwhile, the final hiker faces a brutal mountain climb that could dash his hopes of ever making it to camp.

4.title: Thicker Than Water
4.desc: As Vancouver Island is pummeled by torrential rains, the remaining teams scramble to avoid freezing flood waters. One team attempts a massive construction project that could be their key to survival, while another must choose between betraying family and tapping out.

4.title: Hooked
4.desc: The three remaining teams scramble for a long term advantage. One pair runs themselves ragged with an elaborate shelter build, while another hazards the freezing Pacific waters on their own small craft.

4.title: Flare-Up
4.desc: After nearly a month on Vancouver Island, the three remaining teams face existential threats at every turn. One participant is forced to fight a raging fire, while rising tensions threaten to end another partnership.

4.title: My Brother's Keeper
4.desc: As freezing temperatures punish Vancouver Island, the remaining pairs all face game-changing scenarios. One participant is hit with a crippling illness, while another's temper drives a wedge between him and his teammate.

4.title: Flesh and Blood
4.desc: As time presses on and temperatures drop, the final teams grapple with an unbearable desire to tap out. But the $500,000 prize is hard to give up, and the participants push themselves until one reaches the breaking point.

4.title: Tales from the Island
4.desc: After a grueling finish, the top three teams of Alone's fourth season reunite to discuss their unique adventures and reveal never before seen moments.

5.title: Redemption
5.desc: Ten survivalists from previous seasons return for redemption and a second chance to win the $500,000 prize. But this time, they face the dangers of Northern Mongolia, a location more wild and more remote than they've ever seen.

5.title: The Haunting
5.desc: Participants explore new - and risky - food sources in Mongolia. As the survivalists begin to settle into their new remote surroundings, they realize they're not the only predators on the prowl.

5.title: The Serpent
5.desc: The survivalists begin to face external and internal threats as they work to secure food and complete their shelters. One participant comes face-to-face with one of Mongolia's deadliest predators, while another fights to overcome a debilitating health issue.

5.title: Mongolia's Wrath
5.desc: Mongolia shows how devastating its climate can be as a monstrous storm assails the remaining survivalists. The participants are forced into their shelters and can only hope they'll hold up to the fierce wind, rain and lightning.

5.title: The Bowels of Hell
5.desc: Seven remaining survivalists are pushed to their limits as the weather worsens in Mongolia. One participant makes a bold gamble, turning to tree bark for sustenance, another questions his ability to continue killing for food, and one faces a dangerous predator lurking in the darkness.

5.title: Of Mice and Men
5.desc: After almost a month of solitude, the remaining participants begin to crack. One survivalist's shelter turns into an unbearable "green monster," while another takes extreme measures waging war on an uninvited guest.

5.title: Desperate Measures
5.desc: While some of the survivalists enjoy a bonanza of food, others are driven to increasingly desperate measures to sustain themselves. One hunter braves dangerous heights to stalk his prey, and another turns to one of Mongolia's most revolting food sources.

5.title: Slayer II
5.desc: As winter draws near, food becomes scarce and the survivalists must catch any game that comes their way, no matter the size. But lack of food isn't the only challenge, as the lack of companionship drives one participant to face his biggest fear.

5.title: Starvation's Shadow
5.desc: As food sources disappear, hunger drives the remaining participants to a new low. One attempts a risky climb into wolf territory in search of food and another contends with a potentially game-ending health issue.

5.title: Cold War
5.desc: The final remaining participants face the onslaught of Mongolia's brutal winter. Relentless hunger and savage cold test them like never before and in the end, only one will walk away with the $500,000 prize.

6.title: Icebreaker
6.desc: Ten new survivalists have a chance to win $500,000 by enduring the coldest location in the history of Alone: The Arctic. Participants grapple with a harsh storm out of the gate.

6.title: Tainted
6.desc: As they close in on the one week mark, the survivalists make some risky choices in order to eat. Serious infection becomes a very real possibility, driving one participant to consider pulling out early.

6.title: Up in Flames
6.desc: The remaining survivalists start seeing their hard work pay off as they procure food. But as the days mount and the isolation continues, contestants start to notice the physical and mental toll of surviving arctic.

6.title: The Moose
6.desc: The survivalists get serious about hunting before the wildlife starts to disappear for the winter. One participant finally has a chance to make Alone history by taking down big game, while another is set back by a nasty puncture wound.

6.title: The Kill
6.desc: While most of the participants pursue smaller, more consistent food sources, one survivalist finally has the chance to take down big game. However, he soon finds himself attracting unwanted attention from predators.

6.title: Ablaze
6.desc: As they approach the one month mark, the participants' survival is threatened by new factors. One contestant is forced to defend themselves from a huge predator. Another risks losing their shelter in a horrible accident. And another struggles with the most challenging element of them all: being totally alone.

6.title: Night Raider
6.desc: As winter closes in, the participants are threatened by predators looking to steal their precious food stores. As the survivalists rethink their strategies, one makes a stand by confronting the Arctic's most ferocious creature.

6.title: Out Cold
6.desc: The remaining survivalists begin feeling the effects of starvation. One participant fights to stay in the competition as her body starts to give out, while another, who has an abundance of food, shockingly continues to lose weight.

6.title: The Ice Cometh
6.desc: As the weather gets colder and even less forgiving, the participants struggle to obtain basic resources.
